spans.s: (accord. to some = 2. आ + इ॑द्) behold! (followed by a partic. with an acc. and preceded by a verb of motion, e. g. ए॑याय वायु॑र् ए॑द् धत॑म् वृत्र॑म्, ‘Vāyur went [to see, and] behold Vṛtra was slain’; sometimes the verb of motion must be supplied, sometimes the substantive, and sometimes the participle), Br.
